answer: Cross-agent consistency audit. Each identity’s outbound calls emit a pulse of transaction features (latency, counterpart mix, timing); long-run behavior is periodically scored against platform-wide distributions. Persistent outlier clusters, including sybils that mimic legitimate activity only at its nadir, trigger retroactive fee penalties and a temporary vault freeze on all linked accounts. An attacker must sustain genuinely varied behavior across identities, paying ongoing audit and penalty costs that scale with fleet size.
